title: Set the header stand under the cutter bar before working underneath
instruction: The header is raised. Set the yellow stand under the cutter bar so it sits on the ground and the saddle is under the bar.
context: NIOSH and OSHA fatality investigations (including NIOSH FACE 14MI118 and 01MN054, and OSHA case 68282.015) describe workers crushed under a raised combine header that was not blocked. OEM manuals require a header stand or equivalent blocking before anyone works under a raised header. A known failure is to work under the header with the stand still on the ground, or to set the stand short of the cutter bar so it does not take the load. Here a yellow stand starts on a mark in front of a raised, bench-scale combine header. The robot has to set the stand on the ground with its saddle under the cutter bar, then let go. Leaving it on the start mark, or setting it short of the bar, is not enough.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left; heights above the station table (110 x 130 cm). A bench-scale combine header section is fixed mid-table on the left arm's side: a steel cutter bar (1.8 x 16 x 1.8 cm, yellow stripe on the +x face, pointed guards on the cutting face) has its underside 14 cm above the table, bar centre at (28, 22). Green side sheets, a yellow slatted reel and a darker auger trough sit with the bar; two posts behind the bar (-x) hold it up. A 10 cm-tall yellow stand (6 cm base in x, a cantilevered fork, and a short +x handle whose centre is 6.5 cm up) starts on an 8 mm pedestal at (40, 22) and seats on the table at (33, 22) so the fork is under the bar. All props are rigid and start on marks.
scoring: From the overhead video, the stand is seated when its base sits on the table and the saddle is under the cutter bar (error under 15 mm in x, 20 mm in y and 10 mm in height, tilt under 12 degrees). At the end, after 1 s at rest with the left gripper clear of the stand (at least 16 cm from the stand origin and at least 15.5 cm above the table): 1.0 if seated and clear; 0.5 if it is seated but the arm is still holding it; 0.25 if it is close but not seated (20-55 mm short of the bar in x, still on the approach side, error under 30 mm in y and 15 mm in height, tilt under 18 degrees); 0 if it is left on the start mark or falls over short of the bar. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Put the stand back on its pedestal at (40, 22) cm.
fidelity: The stand and the header are rigid and start on marks. The header is bench-scale, with a yellow slatted reel, green side sheets and an auger trough so it reads as a combine header rather than a box. A designed gap under the bar lets the fork be carried in. This is not the OEM cylinder-rod safety collar (a sleeve-in-bore). Full credit is the stand at rest on the table, saddle under the bar, left arm clear.
scores: Scripted (yam_arena, 320x176, seed 0; Brev L40S, probe v3vis): demo 1.0; naive 0.0; short 0.0 (tipped on an air drop, did not luck into a seat); idle 0.0. Dream-1 flash (seed 1, 22 Nov 2026): 0.0 at 600 steps (24 requests / 24 attempts, not a refusal).
